china_race_dynamics.text: The capabilities of AI are quickly advancing. [...] However, we also know that advancements in technology create new opportunities for bad actors to operate effectively. Our great Congress must be closely monitoring this powerful tool to ensure the application is not misused, but the Government cannot get in the way of American leaders in this sector and their ability to improve the product. [...] As I talk with people in the private sector, it is clear we are in a global AI arms race. Our adversaries are innovating quickly and it is critical that we do not restrict the capabilities of American business. [...] How can we ensure America's leadership in AI and what Government actions could jeopardize this?
china_race_dynamics.context: Opening remarks by Mr. Ezell at a House subcommittee hearing on harnessing AI to defend and secure the homeland.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls the situation a global AI arms race and says American business capabilities must not be restricted.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement clearly endorses the AI arms-race framing, but the speed-over-safety implication is not explicit enough to label.
